crossRefs.note: All that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the people of Ai.

people.name: Ai
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua after initial defeat.

translations.web: All that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the people of Ai.
translations.bsb: A total of twelve thousand men and women fell that day—all the people of Ai.
translations.kjv: And so it was, that all that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the men of Ai.
translations.asv: And all that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the men of Ai.
